sourceText:
Oatmeal Macaroons
By: Kitch-N-Chik
Published: Saturday, December 5, 2009 - 11:12pm

Ingredients




1 cup shortening
1 cup brown sugar
1 cup granulated sugar
1/2 teaspoon vanilla
2 eggs unbeaten
1 1/4 cups flour
1 teaspoon soda
1/2 teaspoon salt
1/2 teaspoon cinnamon
3 cups Quick Oats
1/2 cup chopped nuts

Preparation

1 Place shortening, sugars, vanilla, and eggs in mixing bowl and beat thoroughly. Sift flour, with soda, salt,and cinnamon; add to shortening mixture and mix thoroughly. Fold in Quick Oats and walnuts. 2 Drop on greased cookie sheet. 3 Bake at 350F for 12-15 minutes. Cool about 2 minutes before removing from pan.
